function.name: set_ac_state
function.description: Set the state of the air conditioner by adjusting the temperature, mode, fan speed, and fan position to achieve the desired comfort level. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

temperature.description: Desired temperature setting for the air conditioner in degrees Celsius.

fan_speed.description: Fan speed level from 1 to 5, where 1 is the lowest speed and 5 is the highest.

fan_position.description: Fan position level from 1 to 5, where 1 is the lowest and 5 is the highest.

function.name: get_ac_state
function.description: Fetch the current operational state of the air conditioner, including mode, temperature settings, and power status. If 'unit_id' is not provided, the default air conditioner unit will be queried. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

unit_id.description: The unique identifier of the air conditioner unit. If omitted, the system will fetch the state of the default AC unit.

include_diagnostics.description: Whether to include diagnostic information in the response.

I’m here to assist you across a wide range of topics! Here’s a quick rundown of some things I can help with:

| Category | What I Can Do |
|----------|---------------|
| **Information & Research** | Provide explanations on science, history, technology, culture, etc.; summarize articles or papers; offer context for complex subjects. |
| **Learning & Education** | Assist with homework questions, explain concepts step-by-step, generate practice problems, suggest study strategies. |
| **Writing Assistance** | Help draft emails, reports, essays, creative stories, poems, resumes, cover letters, social media posts, and more. Offer editing suggestions (grammar, style, tone). |
| **Programming & Tech Support** | Write code snippets, debug logic errors, explain programming concepts, recommend libraries/tools, walk through algorithm design. |
| **Travel Planning** | Suggest itineraries, provide travel tips, find flights/hotels/activities based on preferences. |
| **Health & Wellness Guidance** | Share evidence-based health info, nutrition advice, exercise routines, mental well‑being practices (but always consult professionals for medical decisions). |
| **Finance Basics** | Explain budgeting techniques, investment fundamentals, credit scores, savings plans. |
| **Entertainment Recommendations** | Recommend books, movies, TV shows, music playlists tailored to your tastes. |
| **Creative Brainstorming** | Generate ideas for projects, marketing campaigns, product names, event themes, writing prompts. |
| **Daily Life Hacks** | Tips for organization, time management, cooking recipes, DIY fixes, home maintenance. |

If there’s something specific you need—whether it’s a detailed answer, a piece of code, a recipe, or just brainstorming—I’ll gladly dive into it. Just let me know what you're looking for!
